verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etchonhab': Tato ay junok winak ma junok ix ix syak' sti' yak'anoch sb'a t'a yol in k'ab' t'a nazareoal,

maxtzak yal-laj yuk'an wino, ma yuk'an junokxo tas to pajb'inak. Maxtzak yalpax yuk'an wino ochnak winagreal, ma winagre pajb'inak. Max yalpax yuk'an yal sat uwa, ma sloan sat, ma sloan sat t'a takinhal.
Ha t'a jantak tiempo ix yak' sti' chi', manh wal jab'ok syal yab'lan masanil tastak tz'el t'a te' uwa, wach'chom sk'enal ma stz'umal.
Max yalpax sjoxanel xil sjolom masanto slajwi jantak tiempo ix yak' sti' chi' t'ayin, schanhej q'uib' xil sjolom yujto wik yaj a in Jehová in tik.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', max yal-laj sk'och t'a stz'ey junok chamnak,
wach'chom a smam, ma snun schami, ma junok yuk'tak, ma junok yanab', palta max yal-laj sk'och t'a stz'ey yik wach' max kan t'a chukal icha yalan ley. Yowalil wach'nhej yaji yujto wik yaji.
Ha t'a masanil tiempo b'aj ix yak' sti' chi', junelnhej wiknhej yaji.

Talaj ay junok mach junnhej ayek' yet'ok schami, a xil sjolom to wik yaj chi', manhxo wach'ok tz'ajkan icha yalan ley. Yuj chi' ayik slajwi yek'b'at ukeok k'ual ayik sb'oxikan icha yalan ley, ichato chi' sjoxjiel xil sjolom chi'.
Axo t'a yukub'ixial, syik'anb'at chawanhok nok' paramuch yalnhej tas makanhil t'a junok winh sakerdote t'a yichanh in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.

Ha winh sakerdote chi' tz'ak'an junok nok' chi' silab'il yuj smul jun anima chi'. Axo junxo nok' snhusjitz'a nok' smasanil silab'il. Icha chi' tz'aj yak'ji tup smul yuj b'aj ix cham jun anima chi' t'a stz'ey. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', a xil sjolom sq'uib'xi, wik tz'ajxikani.

Tz'elxi yich jun pekti' b'aj ix yak' sti' t'ayin. Ha jantak tiempo ix ek'b'at t'a yalanhtax chi', maxtzak ochlaj sb'isulok, yujto a xil sjolom wik yaji, ix ixtaxeli. Anhejtona' yowalil syik'paxb'at junok nok' kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal silab'il t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik yuj stupan tas ix sk'ulej chi'.
Ayik slajwi jantak tiempoal ix yak' sti' jun anima chi', yowalil sb'at t'a sti' in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.

Ata' syak'och jun silab' t'a wichanh, snhusjitz'a smasanil, haton junok nok' kelem kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal, malaj jab'ok spaltail. Anheja' syak'pax junok nok' nun kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal, malaj jab'ok spaltail. Ha jun chi' silab' yaj yuj yak'ji tup mul. Tz'ak'ji junok nok' ch'ak kalnel malaj jab'ok spaltail silab'il yik junk'olal.

Anhejtona', yowalil syak' junok yune' mooch ixim pan malaj yich, a ixim harina te wach' ayoch t'ay kalab'il yet' akeite. Syak'pax ixim k'oxox pan malaj yich, ayoch akeite t'ay. Junnhej tz'aj yak'an yet' yofrenda t'a ixim trigo yet' wino t'inhantaxon yak'ani.
Ha junok winh sakerdote tz'ak'anoch jun silab' yuj mul chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in yet' silab' to snhusjitz'a smasanil.
Syak'anpax nok' kalnel silab'il yik junk'olal. Junnhej tz'aj yak'an yet' ixim pan malaj yich chi'. Syak'anpax ofrenda t'a ixim trigo yet' pax wino.

Ha jun ix yak' sti' t'a nazareoal chi', sjoxchajel xil sjolom. Ha t'a yichanh in kajnub' sjoxchajeli. Smolk'e xil sjolom ayoch ch'oxnab'ilok to wik yaji, snhusjitz'a t'a kal k'ak', haton k'ak' b'aj stz'a silab' yik junk'olal.

Ayik slajwi sjoxjiel xil sjolom chi', a winh sakerdote tz'ik'ank'e sjenhjab' nok' kalnel tajinakxo chi' yet' jun ixim pan malaj yich ayem t'a yol jun yune' mooch chi' yet' pax jun ixim k'oxox pan malaj yich, syak'anoch winh masanil t'a yol sk'ab' jun ix yak'och sb'a nazareoal chi'.

Slajwi chi', sb'akhanoch juntzanh chi' winh sakerdote chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik. Ha juntzanh chi' sik'b'ilel wikok, yik heb' sakerdote chi' yaji yet' pax snhisk'ol nok' sb'akhchajoch t'a wichanh, xub' nok' to sik'chajkaneli, yik winh sakerdote chi' yaji. Ayik toxo ix lajwi masanil juntzanh chi', a jun yak'nakoch sb'a nazareoal chi', tzaxo yal yuk'an wino.

Haton juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' nazareo: Tato ay junok nazareo chi' syak' sti' yak'an junok ofrenda ek'to t'a yichanhtaxon sleyal, yowalil sk'anab'ajej sk'ulan icha b'aj ix yak' sti' chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal, ayik syalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' eyetisraelal, syal heb' icha tik:
Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a eyib'anh, tzex stanhwani.
Ex yilokab'och Jehová t'a tzalajk'olal, sch'oxokab' swach'k'olal t'ayex.
Xajanokab' tzex yiloch Jehová, yak'okab' junk'olal t'ayex, xchiokab' heb'.
Icha chi' ol yutej heb' in yak'an b'inaj t'a yib'anh heb' etisraelal. Ha inxo ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb', xchi t'a winh.
